name: talk-to-us-cta
title: Talk to us CTA
description: A closing ask led by real people: faces, names and roles, a first-person heading, two actions and a status dot with words for how fast they reply.
docs: Pass one to three people (a name, a role and an optional photo), a title written in the first person, an optional description, the actions, an availability line and a status of online, away or offline. The faces overlap on a ring in the card colour and are hidden from assistive technology because the names are written below them; three names share one row in three equal columns, so none is left alone on a second line. Status is a dot and words together: the dot is solid when online, a ring when away and a thin ring when offline, and the availability text must say the state too, for example Online now, replies in about 10 minutes. The line is a polite status region, so a change is announced once and nothing is read on load. The actions stack on a phone and sit side by side when there is room. Place it after a FAQ, beside pricing or above the footer.
